full_prompt_en: A square monochrome manga illustration shows a bespectacled young man rushing toward the viewer in a strongly foreshortened pose. His head and shoulders dominate the upper center, with tousled dark hair radiating in scratchy strands and a direct, intent gaze through round glasses. The nose, cheekbones, and mouth are modeled with fine crosshatching. A pale long-sleeved shirt stretches across both arms, which angle outward toward the sides of the frame; the dark torso narrows sharply downward into the lower middle. The pose reads as a leap or fast forward dive, suspended above a crowded scene. Across the lower third, dozens of tiny figures fill a fragmented street or event space, their heads, coats, and gestures rendered as light pen marks. Rectangular picture-like fragments overlap behind them, adding separate miniature scenes to the distance. The vast white upper background gives the large figure room to project forward. Dark ink pools in the hair, eyes, and central body, while the crowd remains pale and sketchlike. There is no single realistic light source; broad white paper supplies the highlights, and value is built through layered line density. Hard facial contours contrast with loose, unfinished edges around the far crowd. The extreme scale shift from giant foreground face to miniature people below creates strong depth and urgency. Thin ink strokes, dry pencil-like texture, and open margins make the motion vivid without saturated color.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色漫画插画呈现一位戴眼镜的年轻男子以强烈透视缩短姿态冲向观者。头与肩占上部中央，蓬乱深发以刮擦细丝向外放射，圆眼镜后是直接而专注的目光。鼻、颧骨和嘴由细交叉排线塑形。浅色长袖衬衫沿两臂展开，手臂朝画幅两侧斜出；深色躯干则快速向下收窄到下部中央。姿态像跃起或快速向前俯冲，悬在拥挤场景之上。下三分之一有数十个极小人物填满碎片化街道或活动空间，头、外套和手势都由浅墨笔痕绘成。矩形图像般碎片在他们身后重叠，远方另有独立微缩场景。宽阔白色上部背景给大人物向前冲出的空间。深墨聚在头发、眼睛和中央身体，人群则保持浅淡速写感。没有单一现实光源；宽白纸面提供高光，明度由线条密度叠出。脸部轮廓坚硬，与远处人群松散未完成的边缘对照。巨大近景脸与下方微缩人影之间的极端尺度变化建立强纵深和紧迫感。细墨线、干铅笔般肌理与开放边缘让运动鲜明，而无需饱和颜色。
style_prompt_en: A monochrome manga drawing uses extreme scale contrast and foreshortening to drive motion toward the viewer. Dense black strokes collect around a large upper focal area, with fine crosshatching shaping middle tones and hairline scratches projecting outward. Pale broad planes and open white paper keep the surrounding space airy. A lower band of miniature figures and rectangular fragments is only lightly indicated, creating depth through size and line density rather than color. Edges are crisp at the central gaze-like accents and become loose, partial, and unfinished in the background. Light is the unmarked paper, with shadow formed by accumulated ink. Diagonal arms or winglike extensions spread laterally, countered by a tapering dark center. Fast directional lines and contrasting mark scales create urgency in an otherwise restrained grayscale field.
style_prompt_zh: 单色漫画线画以极端尺度反差和透视缩短推动朝观者的运动。密集黑笔聚在上部大型焦点周围，细交叉排线塑造中灰，发丝般刮线向外放射。浅色宽面与开放纸白保持周围空间通透。下部一带微缩形体和矩形碎片仅被轻描，通过尺寸与线密度而非颜色建立纵深。中央目光般重音的边缘清楚，背景则松散、局部、近乎未完成。光来自未落墨纸面，阴影由累积墨线形成。横向展开的斜臂或翼状伸展与向下收窄的深色中心相对。迅速定向线条和笔痕尺度对照，在克制灰阶色域中制造紧迫感。
theme_en: A bespectacled young man lunging toward the viewer above a crowd
theme_zh: 戴眼镜的年轻男子从人群上方冲向观者
name: Takehiko Inoue
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
